description: This Java source file defines the JpaNotificationRuleDao class, which implements data access operations for NotificationRule entities in a SQL database within the Thingsboard project. It includes methods for querying, checking existence, and managing notification rules based on tenant IDs, trigger types, and other criteria.

classes.name: JpaNotificationRuleDao
classes.description: Data access object for NotificationRule entities, providing methods for querying and managing notification rules in a SQL database.

methods.name: findByTenantIdAndPageLink
methods.description: Retrieves paginated NotificationRules for a tenant based on search text.

methods.name: findInfosByTenantIdAndPageLink
methods.description: Retrieves paginated NotificationRuleInfo objects for a tenant based on search text.

methods.name: existsByTenantIdAndTargetId
methods.description: Checks if a notification rule exists for a tenant with a specific target ID.

methods.name: findByTenantIdAndTriggerTypeAndEnabled
methods.description: Finds notification rules by tenant ID, trigger type, and enabled status.

methods.name: findInfoById
methods.description: Finds NotificationRuleInfo by tenant ID and rule ID.

methods.name: removeByTenantId
methods.description: Deletes all notification rules for a tenant.

methods.name: findByTenantIdAndExternalId
methods.description: Finds a notification rule by tenant ID and external UUID.

methods.name: findByTenantIdAndName
methods.description: Finds a notification rule by tenant ID and name.

methods.name: findByTenantId
methods.description: Retrieves paginated notification rules for a tenant.

methods.name: getExternalIdByInternal
methods.description: Retrieves external ID for a notification rule given its internal ID.

methods.name: findAllByTenantId
methods.description: Retrieves all notification rules for a tenant.

methods.name: getEntityClass
methods.description: Returns the class type of the entity managed by this DAO.

methods.name: getRepository
methods.description: Returns the JpaRepository instance used for database operations.

methods.name: getEntityType
methods.description: Returns the entity type, which is NOTIFICATION_RULE.
